hook: NASA just pulled the plug on the Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory as it fell below 171 miles.

sections.voiceover: NASA just pulled the plug on the Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory as it fell below 171 miles.
sections.visual_cue: Wide orbital shot of the Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory telescope drifting above Earth.
sections.sfx_cue: Low atmospheric hum with subtle satellite static.
b_roll: NASA Science archival graphic of satellite decay
sections.animation_cue: Zoom in on descending altitude indicator

sections.voiceover: On July 3, Katalyst Space Technologies launched the LINK spacecraft from Kwajalein. Arizona engineers built America's first commercial space robot for one daring job. Can the LINK spacecraft save the telescope?
sections.visual_cue: Launch footage of the LINK spacecraft rising from the pad at Kwajalein.
sections.sfx_cue: Rocket thruster rumble building in intensity.
b_roll: Katalyst Space Technologies facility in Arizona

sections.voiceover: Katalyst Space Technologies watched the LINK spacecraft fail to rescue the Swift telescope.
sections.visual_cue: Animation showing the LINK spacecraft attempting to dock with the orbiting telescope.
sections.sfx_cue: Electronic pulsing tone indicating proximity alert.
b_roll: Computer simulation of orbital docking mechanics
sections.animation_cue: Red warning pulse on docking telemetry
sections.transition_out: Fast wipe to final observation logs

sections.voiceover: NASA reported that the Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory conducted its final observation on October 20. The Arizona company failed to boost the orbit.
sections.visual_cue: Final data readout screen showing telescope instruments powering down.
sections.sfx_cue: Soft chime followed by complete silence.
b_roll: NASA Science telemetry dashboard showing mission end
sections.animation_cue: Fade out of active instrument indicators

sections.voiceover: NASA officially ended the science mission below 171 miles.
sections.visual_cue: Distant view of the silent telescope drifting into shadow.
b_roll: Earth curvature against the dark void of space
sections.animation_cue: Slow drift of stars across the frame
